messages:
maria: Quick sync — Harbor Health on-prem deployment window is set for Thu 2026-03-19 02:00-04:00 UTC (2h). This rollout is v1.8.1 + DB patch. Need: deploy owner, smoke runner, rollback lead. Ops needs IP allowlist changes at 01:50 UTC. I'll update the runbook and attach the ticket.

aj: I can own the rollout. I'll be online from 01:45. Plan: canary 10% for first 10m, then 50% for 10m, then full if healthy. Need confirmation that DB migration will run in lock-free mode (we agreed on zero-downtime migration).

sam: I can run smoke/validation after canary is up. Please post the exact smoke commands and endpoints. I'll post pass/fail checks and latency numbers.

maria: Copying the smoke commands to run from the jump host in the customer VPC:

```bash
# health endpoint
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" https://harbor.internal/health

# k8s rollout status
kubectl --context=harbor-prod -n harbor rollout status deploy/api --timeout=5m

# db migrations quick check
psql "$DB_CONN" -c "SELECT id, status, completed_at FROM migrations ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 5;"

# lightweight traffic test
ab -n 200 -c 5 https://harbor.internal/api/v1/status
```

sam: Perfect, thanks. I'll run those and paste results. I'll also check Prometheus p95 and trace samples.

lee: I'll be rollback lead. Backups complete at 01:30, filesystem snapshots at 01:40. Rollback plan summary: 1) restore DB snapshot, 2) scale down new deployment, 3) switch LB back to previous instance pool and update DNS if needed. Restore estimate ~8–12m. Playbook in internal ops: https://intra.redwood/ops/playbooks/harbor-rollback

deploy-bot: Deployment ticket RW-7982 scheduled for 2026-03-19T02:00:00Z by aj. Reminder will be posted at 01:45 UTC. Alert policy: escalate to #incidents if 5xx rate >3% for 5m.

aj: Noted. One outstanding item — firewall rule to add jump host CIDR needs to be applied at 01:55 UTC. @networking please confirm you can make the change and rollback rule is ready.

maria: Quick preflight checklist:
1) Backups & snapshots OK (lee)
2) Firewall allowlist applied (netops)
3) Canary artifact verified (aj)
4) Smoke tokens + test account available (sam)
5) On-call coverage confirmed (maria/aj)
6) Rollback playbook accessible (lee)

lee: Rollback readiness confirmed. I have DB snapshot handles and restore script staged. I'll be standing by at 02:00.

aj: If no blockers, I'll start canary at 02:05 and post updates per step. Will tag everyone on anomalies. :thumbsup:

sam: I'll post smoke test logs and a short verdict (PASS / FAIL) and include p95, error rate, and a few trace ids. If FAIL, I will tag @maria and @lee and request immediate rollback.

maria: Thanks — I'm updating the runbook and the ticket with these owners. I'll also add the firewall change ETA and attach the smoke commands. See RW-7982 for the full plan. Any last blockers?

aj: None from me.

lee: All good here.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled at 2026-03-19T01:45:00Z for RW-7982.

maria: Great — let's keep updates concise in-thread during the window. I'll join the call if anything needs coordination.
